summary: Evofem Biosciences filed an 8-K reporting the entry into a subordinated promissory note with HUB Cyber Security for an aggregate principal amount of $706,304. The note accrues interest at 12% per annum, matures in 11 months, and includes weekly monitoring and one-time administration fees. The proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The filing describes typical debt covenants and prohibited transactions but does not involve a change of control, acquisition, tender, or any other special-situation event. This is a routine debt financing agreement and thus not classified as a special situation.
